supervisor_sizing.entry: 2 tranches: half now, half after the Q3 2026 print (likely ~Nov 3, not yet announced) once the Q4 guide and AI-agent commentary are known
supervisor_sizing.overlap: No direct driver overlap with AAPL/GOOGL/META/TSLA/EL/GPRO. It is partly an inverse hedge on the AI theme: META (Muse) and GOOGL (AI Mode agentic booking) are the channel threats. All are exposed to the Fed's hiking cycle.
supervisor_sizing.reason: The mean ladder implies ~+15% expected price return (median ~$174), but with ~37-39% vol against SPY's ~16% BKNG needs roughly +15-16% total return to win on Sharpe, which is about a 43-45% event on the ladder. Round-2 checks added verified but two-sided evidence and no new edge, so I hold the confidence just under 0.5. The cap is moderate, and the name diversifies a tech-heavy book.
supervisor_sizing.conviction_label_reason: The checked evidence (FY27 consensus intact, ~6%/yr share shrink, ~8% FCF yield, bookings growth in line with Expedia) supports a real but modest expected-return edge over the S&P 500. The unresolved AI-agent de-rating risk and the anchored rather than independent round-2 consensus keep it from being a clear edge.

method: Suggested allocation from the cash to deploy: one joint solve over every name (optimize.py), run after combine.py.

risk_model.note: Annualized vol of the whole account (holdings + all suggested buys, rest in cash): blended vols, recalibrated factor-model correlations.
